title: Modernize Legacy Codebase
problem_statement: The current codebase is written in VB6 and relies on outdated libraries.
risk_if_unaddressed: Continued use of outdated technology may lead to increased maintenance costs and security risks.
suggested_approach: Rewrite the application in C# and replace outdated libraries with modern equivalents.
success_criteria: All legacy components are successfully rewritten in C#.
The application passes all security and QA checks.
